paper_title: Can LLMs Solve longer Math Word Problems Better
caption: (left) and (right) of scaling up SFT dataset across various model scales in the LLaMA-2 family. The results suggest scaling up model scales and SFT dataset can further improve .
model_annotation: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the CoLeG-R (%) across three different models under four distinct training conditions. The horizontal category axis lacks a general title but displays three models in the following order: "LLaMA-2-7B", "LLaMA-2-13B", and "LLaMA-2-70B". The vertical value axis represents "CoLeG-R (%)" on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to slightly above 80, with major tick marks placed at regular intervals of 10 units. At each horizontal axis category, the chart features a group of four contiguous vertical bars. As defined by the legend located in the bottom right corner, these bars represent the conditions "no SFT" (light blue with white diagonal hatching), "+ SFT on $D_0$" (light orange with white horizontal hatching), "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1$" (light purple with white diagonal hatching), and "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1, D_2$" (solid light red). Within the "LLaMA-2-7B" category, the "no SFT" and "+ SFT on $D_0$" bars are the shortest at approximately 66, while the "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1$" and "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1, D_2$" bars measure roughly 81 and 84, respectively. For the "LLaMA-2-13B" group, the "no SFT" bar is at roughly 70, the "+ SFT on $D_0$" bar is near 74, the "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1$" bar represents the tallest value in the entire chart at approximately 85, and the "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1, D_2$" bar is around 80. In the "LLaMA-2-70B" category, the bar heights measure roughly 81 for "no SFT", 82 for "+ SFT on $D_0$", 84 for "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1$", and 83 for "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1, D_2$". The bars within each group are ordered consistently according to the legend rather than by height, and the first three conditions in each group are visually distinguished using various white hatching patterns, contrasting with the solid fill of the final condition.
